local_changes: Added TAP to click at the current pointer position after visual relative movement, without running coordinate re-homing.
Added LONG (800ms left-button hold) and DRAG:dx,dy (held left-button movement) for iPhone long press and swipe gestures.
Added FINE movement, restart advertising after disconnect, and KEY modifier/usage reports with a BLE keyboard/mouse composite descriptor.

active_hid_library.pairing_note: The composite keyboard/mouse report descriptor replaces the original mouse-only descriptor. Forget and pair VersaiOS Mouse again after this upgrade.
